definitions.short: violent ; by implication deadly ; also (in a good sense) brave
definitions.full: H393. akzar אַכְזָר adjective cruel, fierce , of poison ( ראֹשׁ ) Deut 32:33 ; elsewhere of men, fierce Job 41:2 ; as substantive = a cruel one 30:21 (of God), Lam 4:3 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly);
